blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language models can score psychiatric questionnaires from speech, but agreement with self-report may reflect the questionnaire rather than the person. We introduce psychometric representational similarity analysis, a framework for comparing the structure of speech-derived scores, self-report, item wording and theory, and implement it alongside person-level construct scoring in COMPASS 2.0. We show how similarly worded items induce covariance without psychological signal. In pre-registered discovery and confirmation analyses of clinical interviews from 275 participants, language-derived symptom geometry resembled wording more than self-report, with no structure beyond wording detected by the registered tests. Geometric agreement with self-report survived assigning participants someone else’s answers, whereas person-paired scores captured distress more than specific symptoms. Complementary analyses examined counselling quality and wording structure across 34 instruments and the Research Domain Criteria (RDoC) framework. These findings distinguish agreement about psychological structure from evidence that language-derived assessments track individual people.
blocks.zh: 语言模型可以从语音中评分精神病问卷,但与自我报告一致可能反映问卷而非个人. 我们引入了心理计量描述相似性分析,这是比较语音生成分数结构,自我报告,项目措辞和理论的框架,并在COMPAS 2.0中与人级构造分数一起实施. 我们显示类似措辞的物品 如何诱导共性 没有心理信号。 在对275名参加者的临床访谈进行预先登记的发现和确认分析时,语言衍生症状几何学的措辞比自我报告更类似,除了经登记的测试发现的措辞外,没有其他结构。 与自报的几何协议依然有效, 补充分析审查了34个文书的咨询质量和措辞结构以及研究领域标准框架。 这些结论将关于心理结构的一致意见与基于语言的评估跟踪个人的证据区分开来。

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A questionnaire is a list of sentences that becomes, through a person’s answers, a map of their mind. When depression items rise and fall together, we infer symptoms that travel together. When alliance items cohere, we infer a working relationship. The sentences give these patterns meaning, but the evidence is meant to come from the person answering them. A century of psychometrics has exposed exceptions, from negatively worded items’ method factors 18 to scales sharing names or words but not constructs 52 , 72 . Item-text similarity alone predicts much of the correlation among survey responses 4 , 72 , 89 , 37 , 66 .
blocks.zh: 问卷是一个句子清单,通过一个人的答案,成为他们心灵的一幅图. 当抑郁症同时出现和下降时, 我们推断出症状 一起流动。 当联盟出现时,我们推断出一种工作关系。 句子赋予了这些规律的意义,但证据的用意是来自回答它们的人. 一个世纪的心理计量方法暴露出例外,从负面措辞的项目方法因素18到平分分享名称或文字,但没有构建52和72。 仅项目案文就预测了调查答复4、72、89、37、66之间的相关性。

blocks.en: Language-based assessment reverses this arrangement. Rather than asking people to rate items, sentence embeddings, entailment models and large language models score how closely clinical interviews, therapy dialogue or online posts match them 45 , 46 , 61 , 55 , 56 , 54 . Researchers sum these scores into scales, correlate them into networks and compare groups as though they were questionnaire answers. Yet similarly worded items attract the same speech whatever the speaker feels. Their correlations can reproduce the questionnaire’s wording without psychological signal. The resulting map may look coherent, replicate across samples and resemble self-report. Each success invites the same question: how much did the person contribute to the structure we recognize? A model can inherit a convincing map of symptoms before it has located anyone on that map.
blocks.zh: 基于语言的评估推翻了这一安排。 而不是要求人们给物品、句子嵌入、包含模型和大语言模型评分, 研究人员将这些分数归为分数,将它们与网络联系起来,并比较各组,仿佛是问卷答复。 然而,措辞相似的项目吸引了发言者的同一份讲话。 它们的关联性可以在没有心理信号的情况下复制调查问卷的措辞. 由此产生的地图可能看起来是连贯的、在样本中复制的,类似于自我报告。 每一次成功都提出了同样的问题:这个人对我们承认的结构作出了多大的贡献? 一个模型可以继承一个令人信服的症状图 在它找到地图上的任何人之前。

blocks.en: Distinguishing these possibilities requires comparing representations across questionnaire responses, clinicians’ ratings, model outputs and theory. Representational similarity analysis addressed an analogous problem in neuroscience by expressing brain activity, behaviour and computational models as dissimilarity matrices over shared conditions 48 , 17 , 57 . We introduce psychometric representational similarity analysis: to our knowledge, the first framework to compare language-derived questionnaire representations with self-report, wording and theory within this logic. Instrument items become the conditions. Each source supplies an item-by-item geometry: co-endorsement in self-report, co-activation by speech, similarity of item meanings or theoretical grouping. The source can also be another speaker, session or time point. These psychometric representational dissimilarity matrices (RDMs) summarize how each source organizes constructs and permit direct comparison (Fig. 1 ). Geometry describes a population or one speaker’s language over time. Whether a measure tracks the right person requires a separate, person-paired test.
blocks.zh: 要区分这些可能性,就必须对问卷答复、临床医生的评级、模型产出和理论的表述进行比较。 代表性相似性分析通过将大脑活性、行为和计算模型表达为在共同条件下的不相同性矩阵,解决了神经科学中的一个类似问题。 我们引入了心理计量表述相似性分析:据我们所知,这是第一个将语言衍生的问卷表述与这种逻辑中的自我报告、措辞和理论进行比较的框架。 仪器物品成为条件。 每个出处都提供逐项几何:自我报告的共同认可,通过语音共同激活,项目含义或理论分组的相似性. 来源也可以是另一个演讲者,会话或时间点. 这些心理计量的异质性矩阵(RDMs)总结了每个来源如何组织构造并允许直接比较(图1)。 几何描述一个群体或一个演讲者的语言随时间推移。 计量是否跟踪对的人,需要单独进行人与人之间的测试.

blocks.en: Clinical applications also require scores. COMPASS (Computational Mapping of Psychometric Assessment in Speech and Semantics) applies instrument scoring keys to the same item activity profiles, estimating symptoms, alliance or other constructs, following them over a conversation and comparing them between speakers. Our earlier version introduced alliance scoring in psychotherapy transcripts 54 , building on item-based dialogue annotation 55 , 56 , and we subsequently applied it to personality 58 . COMPASS 2.0 connects representations and construct scores, allowing each score to be examined against its underlying geometry (Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh: 临床应用也需要分数. COMPAS(语音和语义心理测量评估的计算绘图)将仪器评分键应用于同一项目的活动简介,估计症状、联盟或其他构象,然后在谈话中进行对比。 我们先前的版本在心理治疗笔录中引入了联盟评分54, 以基于项目的对话注释55, 56为基础, COMPAS 2.0连接了表示和构造分数,使每个分数能够根据它的基本几何来检查(图2.).

blocks.en: Both layers inherit the same confound. Scoring speech embedding 𝐞 \mathbf{e} against item embeddings A A gives activities 𝐩 = A ⊤ ​ 𝐞 \mathbf{p}=A^{\top}\mathbf{e} with covariance A ⊤ ​ Σ ​ A A^{\top}\Sigma A . Under isotropic speech variation ( Σ ∝ I \Sigma\propto I ), their correlation geometry is exactly the item similarity A ⊤ ​ A A^{\top}A . This is the wording null: the geometry expected from isotropic speech carrying no information about the person. Consider the near-duplicate PHQ-8 and PCL-C sleep items. Sleep-related speech raises both scores whether or not depressive and post-traumatic sleep problems co-occur. Because related constructs are deliberately described in related words, this inherited geometry can look psychologically valid. If wording also shapes self-report, the two measurements can agree through a structure that both inherit. Agreement then needs an explanation of its source before it can support a claim about the person. Neuroscience likewise had to account for stimulus and noise structure before interpreting neural geometry 84 , 16 . Topic, length and interviewer also shape speech, so isotropy is a reference, not a complete account of nonpsychological variation. COMPASS 2.0 whitens against wording, treating departures as diagnostic rather than necessarily personal. It checks an empirical within-speaker reference, appropriate only when that variation is nuisance, centres activities on the interview script, tests residual agreement with self-report by item permutation, and scores stance alongside topic.

blocks.en: We tested this framework in pre-registered analyses of two clinical interview corpora with item-level self-reports, re-examined earlier alliance scores in psychotherapy and counselling, and compared wording across 34 instruments and the Research Domain Criteria 40 . In both interview samples and both embedding models, geometry followed wording more closely than self-report. No scorer showed registered evidence of population structure beyond wording. A small exploratory entailment effect disappeared under another reference. Geometric agreement ignored who said what, whereas paired scores tracked distress, for entailment beyond interview length and topic, with a small item-specific excess for embedding scorers in confirmation. Earlier keyed Bond scores tracked relationship talk. Stance scores distinguished counselling quality in a second corpus without robustly outperforming keyed scores of the same items. Across instruments, wording clustered by construct domain, making these controls relevant wherever item texts probe language.
blocks.zh: 我们在两个临床访谈的预先注册分析中测试了这个框架,并用项目层面的自我报告,重新审查了早先联盟在心理治疗和咨询方面的得分,比较了34个仪器和研究领域标准40的措辞。 在访谈样本和嵌入模型中,几何学比自我报告更接近于措辞。 计分员除了措辞外,没有显示登记的人口结构证据。 在另一处参考之下,一个小小的探索性必然效应消失了。 几何协议忽略了谁说,而配对的分数跟踪了危难情况,因为超出访谈长度和话题,而将分数器嵌入的分数器则有少量特定分数。 早前按键的邦德得分追踪关系谈话. Stance在第二套课程中评分优异的咨询质量,而没有在相同项目中评分优于成绩。 在整个文书中,措辞按构建域组合,使这些控制在物品文本探究语言时具有相关性。

blocks.en: Psychometric representational similarity analysis asks each source how the items relate. Similarity means co-endorsement across people for self-report, co-activation by speech for language, related meanings for wording, and shared instrument clusters for theory. Under classical assumptions, split-half reliabilities r 1 r_{1} and r 2 r_{2} across random participant halves bound attainable agreement at about r 1 ​ r 2 \sqrt{r_{1}r_{2}} . blocks.en: We first measured the structure present in the probes before anyone speaks. The similarities among the 8 PHQ-8 and 17 PCL-C items 51 , 6 concentrate in about 6.0 effective dimensions in MiniLM sentence embeddings 70 , 85 and 2.6 in bge-large embeddings 90 (participation ratio of the item-similarity matrix 26 ; the matrices are full rank, with condition number 132 for MiniLM), and three pairs of items across the two instruments are near-duplicates: sleep (cosine 0.90), concentration (0.73) and loss of interest (0.64; Fig. 3 a).

blocks.en: Interview scripts impose a second structure
blocks.zh: 访谈脚本强制了第二个结构

blocks.en: Interview questions impose their own structure. In DAIC-WOZ’s scripted virtual interviews 30 , 15 , question identity was associated with a median 0.110 of item-activity variance across answer windows (one-way η 2 \eta^{2} , range 0.058–0.150), compared with 0.039 for person identity (Fig. 4 a). In E-DAIC 71 , interview phase accounted for 0.071 and person identity for 0.030. Answering different question subsets therefore shapes participants’ averages. Before averaging, we centred each window on its question’s mean among other participants (Methods). This removes estimated question means, not every script effect.
blocks.zh: 面试问题强加了自己的结构。 在DAIC-WOZ的脚本虚拟访谈中,30,15,问题身份与一个中位值0.110的跨答窗口(单向2\eta\2},范围为0.058–0.150)有关,而个人身份为0.039(图4a)。 在E-DAIC 71中,面谈阶段为0.071人,个人身份为0.030人。 因此,回答不同的问题子集决定了参与者的平均数。 在平均值之前,我们把每个窗口都集中在其他参与者(方法)中。 这样可以去除估计的问题表示,而不是每个脚本效果.

blocks.en: Geometry correlated 0.89 with wording across windows and 0.68 across people (Fig. 4 b), falling to 0.63 after centring and 0.40 after whitening. Whitened population geometry was reliable (split-half reliability 0.88 in DAIC-WOZ, 0.93 in E-DAIC). Individual deviations were not (median 0.05, 0.03; Extended Data Fig. 1 ). One interview supplied too little language for individual item geometry, so our tests concern population structure.

blocks.en: Registered tests separate the wording from the symptoms
blocks.zh: 将措辞与症状区分开来

blocks.en: We registered three tests before reading any self-reported item score (Methods). Discovery used DAIC-WOZ (189 participants), and confirmation used E-DAIC (86 participants, autonomous interviews and automatic transcripts). Scorers were MiniLM and bge cosine similarity, and an entailment model 86 , 36 , 91 assessing support or contradiction of first-person symptom statements.
blocks.zh: 在读取任何自报项目分数(方法)之前,我们登记了三次测试。 发现使用DAIC-WOZ(189名参与者),确认使用E-DAIC(86名参与者,自主访谈和自动笔录). 得分者为MiniLM和bge同位素相似性,以及评估第一人称症状说明的支持或自相矛盾的86、36、91等代号。

blocks.en: H1 tested whether naive geometry resembled wording more than self-reported item correlations. It did in discovery (MiniLM: r = 0.68 r=0.68{} versus 0.42, difference 0.26, 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.15 to 0.47; bge: 0.69 versus 0.47, difference 0.22, CI 0.15 to 0.40) and confirmation (MiniLM: 0.63 versus 0.36, difference 0.27, 97.5% CI 0.11 to 0.55; bge: 0.65 versus 0.21, difference 0.44, CI 0.33 to 0.58; Fig. 4 b–d). Self-reported correlations themselves followed wording 4 , 37 (MiniLM: 0.59 discovery, 0.43 confirmation). Shared wording thus accounted for much of naive geometry’s apparent validity. Exploratory adjustment for wording reduced agreement with self-report from 0.42 to 0.03 in discovery and 0.36 to 0.13 in confirmation (bge: 0.47 to 0.12, and 0.21 to − - 0.07).

blocks.en: The residual also depended on the reference. Within-speaker covariance closely resembled wording for embedding scorers ( r = 0.88 r=0.88{} to 0.91). Whitening against it with registered controls unchanged gave partial correlations from − - 0.045 to 0.060 (all P ≥ 0.19 P\geq 0.19{} ; Supplementary Table 1 ), including − - 0.001 for confirmation entailment. Its validity depends on assumptions the data cannot verify (Extended Data Fig. 3 c), so this establishes reference sensitivity, not a nuisance origin. Excluding one confirmation participant with a PCL-C response of 0, outside the 1–5 scale, left every registered conclusion unchanged.

blocks.en: H3 tested whether language-derived scores correlated more with the matching self-reported item than with other items. Specificity was small and inconsistent. Both cosine scorers supported it in confirmation (MiniLM 0.038, CI 0.007 to 0.072; bge 0.042, CI 0.013 to 0.073) but not discovery (Fig. 4 d; Extended Data Table 2 ).

blocks.en: H1 and H2 compare population geometries, which ignore person pairing. H3 and the following read-outs retain it. Reassigning self-reports between participants left geometric agreement exactly unchanged (discovery entailment: 0.33 before and after), while paired measures fell to their null (Fig. 4 f). General-factor agreement fell from 0.49 to a shuffled range of − - 0.15 to 0.14, and COMPASS PHQ-8 agreement with self-reported totals from 0.54 to − - 0.15 to 0.14 (confirmation before shuffling: 0.60, 0.57). This invariance follows from the comparison itself. Reordering the people leaves the correlations among questionnaire items unchanged, so the population RDM retains no record of which report belongs to which interview. Geometry can establish that language organizes items as self-report does. Establishing that it measures the right person requires paired read-outs.

blocks.en: Speech conveys how distressed a person is more than which symptoms they have
blocks.zh: 语言表达一个人有多痛苦 比他们有什么症状

blocks.en: What does speech convey if symptom profiles are poorly recovered? Exploratory analyses compared the first principal components of language-derived and self-reported items from both scales across participants, then examined item-specific correspondence after removing the self-reported general factor (Methods). These components are sample-specific summaries, not independently validated general factors. For entailment, they correlated r = 0.49 r=0.49{} (95% CI 0.38 to 0.59) in discovery and 0.60 (0.44 to 0.72) in confirmation. Mean language-derived item scores correlated 0.53 and 0.58 with PHQ-8 totals. Cosine scorers carried less general-factor information (bge 0.26, 0.52; MiniLM 0.07, 0.33). Entailment’s association persisted beyond speech length and questionnaire-topic activation: after partialling answer-window count, word count and topic activation, COMPASS PHQ-8 scores correlated 0.52 (95% CI 0.43 to 0.61) and 0.49 (0.33 to 0.63) with self-reported PHQ-8 totals. Cosine-score correlations shrank (MiniLM: 0.15, 0.39 to 0.07, 0.12; bge: 0.26, 0.53 to 0.16, 0.40; Supplementary Table 4 ). Item-specific convergence was much smaller (same-item minus different-item correlation 0.005 to 0.073; Fig. 4 e). Agreement lay mainly in general distress, reminiscent of hierarchical psychopathology models 10 , 47 , while apparent item structure largely belonged to the questionnaire. The differently scaled statistics do not partition symptom information. Both paired read-outs vanished when self-reports were shuffled (Fig. 4 f). Speech therefore carried information tied to the speaker even where its apparent symptom structure largely reflected the probes. The distinction between these findings is what permits a useful signal to survive a critical test of its interpretation.
blocks.zh: 如果症状特征恢复不良,话语会传达什么? 探讨性分析比较了与会者从两个比额表中得出的语文项目和自报项目的第一主要组成部分,然后在删除自报的一般因素(方法)后审查了具体项目对应情况。 这些组成部分是特定样本摘要,并非独立验证的一般因素。 就所涉事项而言,在发现时它们与r = 0.49 r = 0.49= (95% CI 0.38至0.59)和确认值为0.60 (0.44至0.72)相关。 平均语言衍生项目得分与PHQ-8总分相挂钩。 余弦计分员携带的一般因子信息较少(bge 0.26, 0.52;miniLM 0.07, 0.33)。 在部分回答窗口数、字数和专题活化后, COMPAS PHQ-8的分数与自报的 PHQ-8 总分相接0.52分(95% CI 0.43至0.61分)和0.49分(0.33至0.63分)。 余弦-分分数关系缩小(米尼LM:0.15、0.39至0.07、0.12;bge:0.26、0.53至0.16、0.40;补充表4)。 具体项目趋同程度要小得多(同项目减去不同项目的相关性为0.005至0.073;图4e)。 协议主要表现为普遍的困扰,令人回想起层次分明的精神病学模式10、47,而明显的物品结构基本上属于问卷。 不同比例的统计数据没有分割症状信息。 当自我报告被洗刷后,两个对齐的读出都消失了(图4f)。 因此,即使发言的明显症状结构在很大程度上反映了探测器,发言也包含了与发言者有关的信息。 这些结论之间的区别使得一个有用的信号能够经受住对其解释的重要考验。

blocks.en: The therapeutic alliance, psychotherapy’s most robust process predictor of outcome 21 , raises the same problem. Of the Working Alliance Inventory’s 36 items 38 , 81 , 35 , 14 are reverse-keyed: relationship discomfort, for example, counts against alliance. COMPASS originally scored client and therapist turns by keyed sums of cosine similarities to their respective forms 54 . Yet cosine similarity scarcely distinguishes a statement from its reversal 20 . Forward and reverse client-form items were as similar in MiniLM (mean 0.55) as forward items among themselves (0.55; Fig. 5 a). Keyed cosine sums therefore contrast forward and reverse topics rather than relationship quality. Talking about trust and expressing trust are different acts. A discussion of its absence may activate the same topic as an expression of confidence in the therapist, even though their implications for the alliance point in opposite directions.

blocks.en: Confirmation contained 156 videos, and transcript screening identified 8 sessions containing AnnoMI material under different identifiers. The corpora were therefore not fully separate. Sensitivity analyses resampled whole videos, removed matched sessions, added 16 previously excluded sessions with neither identifier nor transcript matches, or dropped overlong segments (Supplementary Tables 2 , 3 ). Stance AUCs remained 0.68–0.69, but the lower confidence bound for superiority ranged from − - 0.019 to 0.013. Quality separation was robust, superiority was not. Negative screening cannot establish independence of actors, therapists or productions. Replicated earlier scoring also exceeded chance in confirmation (AUC 0.65, 95% CI 0.56 to 0.73), partly through session length ( r = 0.45 r=0.45{} ), and tracked topic and length more closely than stance. Which signal better distinguished quality thus depended on the corpus. Quality labels are not alliance ratings: these results support counselling-quality discrimination, not validation of Task, Bond and Goal scores.

blocks.en: Wording clusters by construct domain across instruments
blocks.zh: 通过构建跨工具域来表达词组

blocks.en: We then tested whether this artefact extends beyond the symptom and alliance instruments. We assembled 702 items and definitions from 35 probe banks (Methods). They covered clinical symptoms of depression, anxiety, trauma, suicidality, psychosis, somatic distress and alcohol use, rated by patients or by clinicians 49 , 5 , 43 , 77 , 34 , 7 , 68 , 59 , 78 , 65 , 42 , 2 , 50 , 74 ; the alliance; the coding of clinical interaction (MITI 63 and VR-CoDES 92 , 14 ); personality (IPIP 28 , 27 and TIPI 29 ), which we have previously tracked in psychotherapy dialogue 58 ; well-being 80 , self-esteem 75 , perceived stress 11 , loneliness 73 , 39 , 13 , decentering 23 , rumination 82 , self-compassion 69 and emotion regulation 31 ; and the construct definitions of the Research Domain Criteria 40 , 12 .
blocks.zh: 然后,我们测试这种动脉是否超出了症状和联盟手段的范围。 我们从35个探测库(方法)收集了702个物品和定义。 它们包括抑郁症、焦虑症、创伤、自杀症、精神病、身体痛苦和酗酒的临床症状,由患者或临床医生评定为49、5、43、77、34、7、68、59、78、65、42、2、50、74;联盟;临床互动编码(MITI 63和VR-CoDES 92、14);人格(IP 28、27和TIPI 29),我们以前在心理治疗对话58中跟踪过这些症状;福祉80、自尊75、感觉压力11、孤独73、39、13、体面23、反射82、自我满足69和情绪调控31;研究 Domain标准40、12的构建定义。

blocks.en: With both embedders, items organized by construct domain (Fig. 6 a). For a median bank, the nearest neighbour of 0.05 of its items lay in another domain (MiniLM; 0.00 for bge). The exceptions were scales written as short adjectives or statements of well-being: the adjective pairs of TIPI (0.70 of items) mostly neighboured the one-word item names of clinician rating scales, and the items of WHO-5 (0.40) neighboured personality and psychosis-proneness items. Cross-instrument neighbours within the same domain were common, spanning parallel forms, revisions and short versions (every PHQ-8 item’s nearest neighbour was its PHQ-9 counterpart) to distinct instruments for the same condition (GAD-7: 0.86 of items; Fig. 6 c). Keeping each of the 12 texts that occur in more than one bank only once left the median shares unchanged. The 49 construct definitions of the Research Domain Criteria, written to cut across diagnoses, still clustered by their domain: their nearest neighbour lay in the same domain for 0.82 of definitions, against 0.18 expected by chance (Extended Data Fig. 2 ).

blocks.en: Banks occupied few effective dimensions (bge: 1.3–2.9), largely because embeddings share a dominant direction 19 , 64 . Removing it raised dimensionality to at most 16.8 (Fig. 6 b). Instruments thus bring their own low-dimensional, domain-structured geometry to language scoring, where it reappears in the item scores. These clusters arise from descriptions of constructs before any participant response enters the analysis. Their interpretability makes them useful for comparing instruments and simultaneously makes them a plausible source of apparent psychological structure when the same texts are used to score speech.
blocks.zh: 银行很少使用有效的维度(bge:1.3–2.9),主要是因为嵌入物具有主导方向19、64。 删除后,其维度提高到了最多16.8(图6b)。 因此,仪器将自己的低维,域结构几何带入语言分数,在项目分数中重新出现. 这些集群产生于在任何参与者的答复进入分析之前对结构的说明。 它们的可解释性使它们在比较仪器时有用,同时当使用相同的文本来评分语音时,它们也成为表面心理结构的可信来源.

blocks.en: Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论情况

blocks.en: Psychometric representational similarity analysis places sources of psychometric information in a common format. COMPASS 2.0 turns these representations into construct scores. Their first lesson is that an instrument contributes structure before a person contributes evidence. Wording dominated language-derived symptom geometry, and interview scripts imposed further structure. Beyond both, the registered test detected no population structure matching self-report, while one scorer’s small exploratory residual depended on the reference. Speech conveyed general distress moderately well and specific symptoms much more faintly. Earlier keyed Bond scores likewise tracked relationship talk. Stance scoring distinguished counselling quality in a second corpus, but topic measures performed better in discovery and stance’s advantage was not robust. Session topics, studied through psychotherapy topic models 53 , can themselves carry quality information.
blocks.zh: 心理计量表达相似性分析将心理计量信息来源放入了通用格式. COMPAS 2.0将这些表示转化为构造分数. 他们的第一个教训是,在某人提供证据之前,一种工具有助于结构。 文字主导了语言衍生的症状几何学,而采访脚本则强加了进一步的结构. 除此之外,登记测试没有发现与自我报告相匹配的人口结构,而一名计分员的小型探索性残留取决于参考。 发言传达了一般的忧患,其症状略为轻微。 早前按键的邦德得分同样跟踪关系谈话. Stance在第二套教材中评分优异的咨询质量,但专题措施在发现方面表现较好,立场优势不强。 通过心理治疗主题模型53研究的会话主题本身可以携带高质量的信息.

blocks.en: The second lesson concerns validation. Population RDMs remain unchanged when self-reports are assigned to the wrong speakers. Their agreement shows that language organizes items as self-report does, not that it measures the right person. RDMs can also describe one speaker’s language over time. Person-level validity requires paired measures, including COMPASS scores and item correspondence. Here, those measures tracked distress and vanished under shuffling. Validation needs both layers, with a clear account of the question each answers. The shuffle makes a property of the estimand visible: population geometry deliberately discards person identity to describe relationships among items. It is well suited to that question. Increasing its correlation with a target cannot supply a correspondence between people that the comparison never used. Validation must preserve the distinctions the intended interpretation depends on.
blocks.zh: 第二个教训是验证。 向错误的发言者提供自我报告时,人口最终结果保持不变。 他们的协议表明,语言组织项目是自我报告,而不是衡量正确的人。 RDMs 也可以随时间推移描述一个演讲者的语言. 人级有效性要求配对措施,包括COMPAS分数和项目对应. 在这里,这些措施追踪了危难,并在被打乱后消失了。 验证需要两层,每个答案都有清楚的说明. 洗发使"印象"的地产显出:人口几何刻意丢弃人物身份来描述物品之间的关系. 它非常适合这个问题。 增加它与目标的关系不能提供比较从未使用过的人群之间的对应关系. 验证必须保留意图解释所依赖的区别。

blocks.en: Language retains clinical information, but language-derived item structure cannot be accepted at face value. Symptom networks, factor structures and profiles, increasingly preferred to sum scores 24 , 25 , require a wording baseline. Report geometric agreement with item texts, centre activities on eliciting questions, and test residual structure against a declared reference. Examine alternatives such as within-speaker covariance under their stated assumptions. Pair person-level read-outs with person shuffles, and interpret keyed cosine sums as topic measures unless the scorer distinguishes stance. This procedure needs item texts, scored language and, where available, item-level self-reports. It applies unchanged across instruments and taxonomies such as the Research Domain Criteria, across sessions and moving windows, and to two speakers’ geometric alignment within conversations. Clinicians’ ratings, theories and simulated respondents can supply further RDMs against which language representations and their COMPASS scores are checked.
blocks.zh: 语言保留了临床信息,但从语言衍生出的项目结构不能被接受于面值. 症状网络、因子结构和剖面图越来越倾向于总分24分、25分,因此需要一个措辞基线。 报告与项目文本的几何协议、关于引出问题的核心活动以及对照已宣布的参考标准测试残余结构。 根据声明的假设,审查其他办法,如发言方内部的同化。 将人级读出与人级洗牌对等,并将按键的同位素总和解释为主题度量,除非计分者区分出姿态. 这一程序需要项目文本、打分语言和(如有)项目一级的自我报告。 它适用于各种仪器和分类,如研究领域标准、会议和移动窗口,以及对话中两个发言者的几何校正。 临床医生的评分、理论和模拟答卷人可以提供进一步的RDM,对照这些RDM来检查语言表现及其COMPAS的分数。

blocks.en: Two literatures meet here. Survey research shows that item wording predicts response correlations 4 , 72 , 89 , 37 , 66 , suggesting that questionnaire measurement is partly semantic. This semantic structure is informative about how instruments organize their subject matter. Our question begins when those descriptions are used as probes to assess a new speaker. Language-based assessment then faces the converse hazard: text-derived scores inherit text geometry without person-level signal, and shared wording can produce agreement with self-report. Neuroscience’s treatment of stimulus and noise structure provides an analogy 84 , 16 . Probe whitening rescales item coordinates by reference covariance rather than weighting dissimilarity-estimate precision. Its validity therefore depends on the reference’s account of nuisance. Within-person and between-person structure need not coincide 62 , 1 , so no reference is universally appropriate. Removing a pattern is not sufficient evidence that it was a confound. The assumptions that make a covariance a nuisance reference must also distinguish it from the signal one hopes to retain. The simulations make this requirement concrete: a seemingly stronger correction can erase genuine structure or reverse its sign.
blocks.zh: 二相文学相会于此. 调查研究表明,项目措辞预测了答复的关联性,即4、72、89、37、66,表明问卷计量部分是语义性的。 这种语义结构提供了资料,说明文书如何组织其主题。 我们的问题始于这些描述被用作评估一位新发言者的探测器。 然后,基于语言的评估会面临反向危险:文本得分继承文本几何而无人级信号,共享措辞可以与自报产生一致. 神经科学对刺激和噪声结构的处理提供了一个类比 84, 16。 被探测出白化后通过参考共变来调整项目坐标,而不是加权差-估计精度. 因此,其有效性取决于参考文献对骚扰的描述。 个人内部和人与人之间的结构不需要重合62,1,所以没有参考普遍合适. 消除一个模式不足以证明它是一个困惑。 使共性成为烦恼的提法的假设也必须与人们希望保留的信号区分开来。 模拟使这一要求具体化:一个看似更强烈的更正可以抹去真正的结构或倒置其标志.

blocks.en: Several limits matter. Samples were modest (189, 86 participants), with one interview each and short answers (median 12, 8 words per window). Automatic confirmation transcripts add another source of error. Small item-specific effects could be missed, and individual geometry remained beyond reach. Registered-test power was high only for strong structure (94% at g = 0.4 g=0.4 , 15% at g = 0.2 g=0.2 for 189 simulated people). Additive Gaussian simulations omit normalized embeddings, ordinal self-reports and estimated targets from the full pipeline. Whitening diagnoses departures from a reference rather than estimating personal structure, with inference conditional on the 25 fixed items. About a fifth of windows contained only one or two words, scored without their question. Weak scores therefore do not establish absent symptom information in the conversation. Larger models may read context and stance better than our compact local models, but their item-worded prompts still require the same null. Alliance analyses used demonstration-session quality, not alliance ratings. Four-turn exchanges and third-person statements may provide insufficient context, and contrasting corpus results warrant direct alliance ratings, longer exchanges and larger models. Sensitivity analyses only partly address repeated videos and shared material. Response styles, interviewer choices and setting-specific topics impose further structure.
blocks.zh: 有几个限度很重要。 样本不多(189个,86个参与者),每个面试一次,回答简短(中间12个,每个窗口8个字). 自动确认记录会增加另一个出错来源. 特定小项的效应可能会被忽略,个别几何仍然遥不可及. 注册测试的功率仅高于强结构(94%为克=0.4克=0.4,15%为克=0.2克=0.2,189名模拟者)。 Additive Gaussian模拟省略了正常嵌入,平面自报和整个管道的估计目标. 怀特宁诊断偏离了参考,而不是估计个人结构,推断的条件是25个固定项目. 大约五分之一的窗口中只包含一到两个单词,得分时没有他们的疑问. 因此,低分数不能证明谈话中没有症状信息。 较大的模型可能比我们紧凑的本地模型更能理解上下文和姿态,但是其标有项目字的提示仍然要求同样的无效. 联盟的分析采用演示会质量,而不是联盟评级。 四轮交流和第三人称声明可能提供不充分的上下文,而对比体结果需要直接的联盟评级,较长的交流和更大的模式. 敏感性分析只涉及部分重复的视频和共享材料。 反应风格,采访者选择和特定设定的主题都强制要求进一步的结构.

blocks.en: The framework suggests a programme of measurement experiments. Longer language records paired with item-level questionnaires, such as histories of online posts, could support individual geometries. Direct alliance ratings would permit comparison of topic and stance against alliance itself. Further tools from representational similarity analysis include cross-validated distances for unbiased person-level geometries 84 , resampling items as well as people to generalize beyond the instrument, and flexible models estimating how speech weights item features 17 . Topological comparisons emphasizing neighbourhoods over noisier long distances may improve robustness 57 . Acoustic and visual representations offer further applications, with identity and recording channel imposing structure as wording does here. A further test would vary probe wording while holding a person’s language fixed, then vary the speaker while holding the probes fixed. Together, these interventions could reveal which features of an assessment travel with the instrument and which travel with the person.
blocks.zh: 该框架提出了计量实验方案。 较长的语言记录与在线帖子的历史等项目级调查问卷相配合,可以支持个人的地理计量。 直接的联盟评级可以比较主题和立场与联盟本身。 代表性相似性分析的其他工具包括:无偏见的人级地貌测量的交叉验证距离 84,重新取样项目和在仪器之外通用的人,以及估计语音权重的灵活模型 17. 注重长距离噪声街区的地貌比较可以提高强度 57 (英语). 声道和视觉表示法提供了更多的应用,其身份和录音通道像这里的措辞一样强制结构。 进一步的试验将改变探测器的措辞,同时固定一个人的语言,然后改变扬声器,同时固定探测器。 这些干预措施可以共同揭示评估旅行中携带文书的哪些特征以及携带个人的哪些特征。

blocks.en: A questionnaire is a theory of a person written in sentences. A model reading people through those sentences can return the theory as though it were the person. Psychometric representational similarity analysis places both in one space, allowing us to ask which is speaking. The promise of language-based assessment rests on this distinction: human expression may exceed the categories through which we choose to read it. A convincing measure must leave room for what the person says to change what the instrument leads us to expect.
blocks.zh: 问卷是用句子书写的一个人的理论. 一个模型通过这些句子读取人们,可以把理论还原成是人. 心理测量的相似性分析将两者放在一个空间里,让我们可以问出哪个在说话。 基于语言的评估的希望在于这一区别:人的表达可能超过我们选择阅读的类别。 一项令人信服的措施必须给当事人所说的留下余地,以改变我们期待的工具。

blocks.en: Methods
blocks.zh: 方法

blocks.en: DAIC-WOZ 30 , 15 contains semi-structured clinical interviews conducted by a virtual human controlled by a human operator, with human transcripts and speaker turns. We used the 189 interviews with transcripts (participants 300–492). E-DAIC 71 extends the corpus with interviews conducted by an autonomous agent; we used participants 600–718 (86 interviews), for which automatic transcripts of the participant’s speech are distributed. Self-reported PHQ-8 items 51 (0–3) and PCL-C items 6 (1–5; one response in the confirmation sample was coded 0) are available for all participants. Both corpora are available from the University of Southern California Institute for Creative Technologies under a data use agreement, and all processing was local. The psychotherapy sessions came from a licensed collection of transcribed counselling and psychotherapy sessions (Alexander Street), deduplicated by content to 786 unique sessions with 180,547 turns; sessions carry collection tags (anxiety 498, depression 374, schizophrenia 71, suicidal 12; 159 sessions with several tags) but no outcome labels. AnnoMI 88 contains 133 transcribed motivational-interviewing demonstrations labelled as high or low quality. The high- and low-quality counselling corpus 67 contains 258 transcribed sessions with the same labels. Our loader set aside 74 of them as shared with AnnoMI: 53 share a source video identifier, and 21 had no resolvable identifier and were treated as shared by an error in the loader. This left 184 sessions from 156 videos for confirmation; a later transcript check found that 8 of them were AnnoMI material under another identifier (Supplementary Note 2). Before this study, the interview corpora had been used for other analyses of depression ratings; no item-level self-report was read by the code of this study before the registration, and no quality label was compared with any score before the alliance registration.
blocks.zh: DAIC-WOZ 30,15包含由人类操作者控制的虚拟人进行的半结构临床访谈,并有人类笔录和扬声器转弯. 我们用189次访谈记录(300-492名参与者)。 E-DAIC 71将调查对象扩大到由自主代理人进行的面谈;我们使用了600-718(86次面谈)参与者,为此分发参与者发言的自动记录。 自报的PHQ-8项目51(0-3)和PCL-C项目6(1至5;确认样本中的一个答复被编码为0)可供所有与会者使用。 根据一项数据使用协议,南加州大学创意技术研究所可以提供这两所公司,所有处理都是本地的。 心理治疗课程来自有执照的转录咨询和心理治疗课程集(Alexander街),内容被简化为786个独特的课程,有180 547个转会;课程带有收集标签(焦虑498个、抑郁374个、精神分裂71个、自杀12个;159个课程带有若干标签),但没有结果标签。 AnnoMI 88包含133个被标为高或低质量的被转录的动机性访谈演示. 67号高质和低质咨询书载有258个带有相同标签的转录会话。 我们的加载器预留了其中74个与AnnoMI共享:53个共享源视频标识符,21个没有可解的标识符,被作为加载器出错共享. 这让156个视频的184个环节得到确认;后来的笔录检查发现,其中8个是AnnoMI材料,属于另一个标识(补充说明2)。 在这次研究之前,采访的Corpora曾被用于对抑郁症评级的其他分析;注册前本研究的代码没有读取项目级自报,也没有将质量标签与联盟注册前的任何分数进行比较.

blocks.en: The symptom items were the 8 PHQ-8 and 17 PCL-C items. The alliance items were the 36 items of the client, therapist and observer forms of the Working Alliance Inventory 38 , 79 , scored on Task, Bond and Goal with 14 reverse-keyed items, and the client-form wording used by our earlier method 54 . The further banks were the MITI 4 behaviour codes 63 , the VR-CoDES cue, concern and response definitions 92 , 14 , the 50-item IPIP Big-Five markers 28 , 27 , TIPI 29 , the UCLA Loneliness Scale version 3 and its three-item form 73 , 39 , the six-item De Jong Gierveld scale 13 , WHO-5 80 , the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale 75 , the Perceived Stress Scale 11 , the decentering items of the Experiences Questionnaire 23 , the brooding and reflection items of the Ruminative Responses Scale 82 , the Self-Compassion Scale short form 69 , the Emotion Regulation Questionnaire 31 , clinical inventories (PHQ-9, GAD-7, PCL-5, the Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale, K10, PHQ-15, AUDIT, PQ-B and CAPE-42 49 , 77 , 7 , 68 , 43 , 44 , 50 , 74 , 59 , 78 , the BDI-II item titles 5 , and the item definitions or names of HAM-A, BPRS, PANSS, SANS and SAPS 34 , 65 , 33 , 42 , 2 , 3 ) and the 49 construct and subconstruct definitions of the Research Domain Criteria matrix in 6 domains 40 , 12 . Texts were taken verbatim from the published sources (Supplementary Table 6 ), instruction stems were excluded and each code definition was represented once; copyrighted texts were used for analysis only and are not redistributed.
blocks.zh: 症状是8个PHQ-8和17个PCL-C物品。 联盟项目是《工作联盟清单》第38和79号的客户、治疗师和观察员形式的36个项目,在《任务》、《邦德和目标》上有14个倒键项目,以及我们先前的方法54所使用的客户形式措辞。 其他银行有MITI 4行为规范63、VR-CoDES提示、关切和反应定义92、14、IPIP 5大标记的50个项目28、27、TIPI 29、UCLA 孤独度表版3及其3个项目73、39、6个项目D Jong Gierveld分级13、WHO-5 80、Rosenberg自评分级75、透视压力分级11、经验调查表23的正版项目82、自评分级69、情感分级调查表31、临床清单(PHQ-9、GAD-7、PCL-5、哥伦比亚自杀率分级、K10、PHQ-15、AUDIT、PQ-B和CAPE-42、77、7、68、43、44、50、50、50、50、59和反射线分级82、SAM、3-PNS和48、S、3-PAS、4、4、4、SAP、4、4、4SU、4、4、4、PA、4、4、4A、4、4、4、4A 文本逐字取自已出版的资料来源(补充表6),指令出处被排除在外,每个代码定义都有一次表述;版权文本只用于分析,没有重新分配。

blocks.en: In DAIC-WOZ, consecutive participant lines between two interviewer lines formed one answer window (10,533 windows; median 55 per participant), grouped by the most recent interviewer question (108 questions). In E-DAIC, recognized segments separated by pauses shorter than 3 s were merged into windows (5,214; median 60 per participant), grouped by decile of session time. In psychotherapy and counselling sessions, the unit was the speaker turn. Annotations in brackets were removed.
blocks.zh: 在DAIC-WOZ中,两个采访者行相接的参与者行会形成一个答案窗口(10,533个窗口;每个参与者中值55个窗口),由最近的采访者提问(108个问题)分组. 在E-DAIC中,以短于3 s的暂停分隔的识别段被合并为窗口(5,214;每名参与者的中位数为60),按会话时间的十分之一分组. 在心理治疗和咨询课程中,该单位是演讲者。 括号内的说明被删除。

blocks.en: Cosine scorers embedded speech units and item texts with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 70 , 85 (revision 1110a243) or bge-large-en-v1.5 90 (revision d4aa6901), normalized the embeddings and took inner products. The entailment scorer was nli-deberta-v3-base 36 , 86 , 8 (revision 6c749ce3). The premise was the answer window and the hypotheses were 42 atomic first-person statements of the 25 items (items naming several symptoms were split into parts); an item’s score was the maximum over its parts of P ⁡ ( entailment ) − P ⁡ ( contradiction ) P(\text{entailment})-P(\text{contradiction}) . On neutral sentences the scorer gave a mean of − - 0.19, and scoring the item texts against the atoms gave a mean of 0.45 on the same item and − - 0.07 on different items; this probe-confusion matrix K K served as a second control for the entailment scorer. All models ran locally on CPU with pinned revisions.
blocks.zh: 余弦计分器嵌入式语音单元和项目文本有: All-MiniLM-L6-v2 70,85 (修订版:1110a243)或bge-great-en-v1.5 90 (修订版:d4aa6901),使嵌入式规范化并取取出内置产品. 配分器为nli-deberta-v3-base 36,86,8(修订版6c749ce3). 前提是答案窗口,假设是25项的42个原子第一人称声明(命名若干症状的项目被分割成部分);一个项目的分数是其P-Q(引出)-P-Q(矛盾)P(\text{尾端}-P(\text{contraction})的最大分数. 在中性句子上,计分员给出了−-0.19的平均值,对原子的计分文字在同一项上给出了0.45的平均值,对不同项给出了−-0.07的平均值;这一探测-聚变矩阵K K成为了计分员的第二个控制。 所有型号都在当地运行在CPU上,并有被绑定的修改.

blocks.en: Psychometric representational similarity analysis follows the logic of representational similarity analysis 48 . The items play the role of the experimental conditions, and each source supplies its own measurement channels: speech units or participants’ mean profiles for language, participants for self-report, and embedding dimensions for item texts. A psychometric RDM is computed for each source over the same conditions, theories enter as model RDMs, and sources are compared by the second-order similarity of their RDMs. The covariance C C (equation ( 2 )) is the centred second-moment matrix of the item activity patterns, from which distances follow: C j ​ j + C k ​ k − 2 ​ C j ​ k C_{jj}+C_{kk}-2C_{jk} is the squared Euclidean distance between the centred activity patterns of items j j and k k (scaled by 1 / ( T − 1 ) 1/(T-1) ), and 1 − r j ​ k 1-r_{jk} is half the squared distance between their standardized patterns. Trait items have served as conditions in neural representational similarity analysis 41 ; here the representations come from language, self-report, item texts and theory. The wording null is a feature model in the sense of representational model analysis 17 : item activities are the item embeddings weighted by speech, so that C = A ⊤ ​ Σ ​ A C=A^{\top}\Sigma A , and an isotropic prior on the weights predicts C ∝ M C\propto M . Whitening expresses speech covariance in an orthonormal basis of the item embeddings, removing the feature model’s prediction in a step analogous to multivariate noise normalization 84 . Item permutation is the condition-label randomization test of representational similarity analysis 48 , 83 . blocks.en: Item activities of each window were centred on the mean of the windows answering the same question (or in the same phase) from all other participants, so that no participant’s own windows entered their centring, except for 13 windows in questions answered by a single participant, which were centred on their own mean. A participant’s profile was the mean of their centred windows; naive profiles used the uncentred activities, as in standard practice. Language geometry was the correlation (naive) or covariance (for whitening) of profiles across participants; self-reported geometry was the correlation of item scores across the same participants. For the entailment scorer, M M was the mean of the two embedders’ similarity matrices.

blocks.en: Twenty-five unit-norm item vectors in 128 dimensions formed eight wording clusters, three of which held one item from each of two instruments. True item correlations mixed a wording-aligned part (items loading on their cluster) and a wording-free part (three random factors) in equal measure, which gave a correlation of 0.50 between the true and wording geometries. Each simulated person had item levels drawn with these correlations, a speech mean g ​ A ​ 𝐳 gA\mathbf{z} plus person-level variation unrelated to the items, and 155 windows of independent noise; activities were projected onto the items. We ran 200 samples of 189 people for g ∈ { 0 , 0.1 , 0.2 , 0.4 } g\in\{0,0.1,0.2,0.4\} and recorded the correlations of the naive, whitened and exactly deconvolved geometries with the truth and with the wording. A further simulation compared the Freedman–Lane test after whitening by M M or by the within-speaker covariance (55 windows per speaker; 200 samples without and 100 with person signal, so that a false-positive rate of 5% has a Monte Carlo standard error of about 1.5 percentage points; 499 permutations) in four conditions: topic variation of the same shape between and within speakers; stronger between-speaker topic variation of the same shape; between- and within-speaker topic variation along different item-cluster directions; and genuine within-speaker item dynamics with the same correlation structure as the person levels, without topic variation. These simulations are stylized additive Gaussian models, not reproductions of the full pipeline. The false-positive rate and power of the registered Freedman–Lane test were estimated in separate runs (200 samples at g = 0 g=0 and 100 at g = 0.2 g=0.2 and 0.4 0.4 , for 189 and 86 people; 999 permutations each). A second simulation added question-specific content and different question subsets per person, and a third generated forward and reverse alliance items sharing topic wording.

Out-of-range response: the confirmation tests without participant 683. Alliance: bootstrap over whole source videos (5,000 resamples); a transcript screen of every session against every AnnoMI session (the share of the session’s word 5-grams contained in one AnnoMI session; text match at 0.3 or more, one threshold throughout; within the registered confirmation sample the observed values were at most 0.027 or at least 0.54, a gap that does not hold for all excluded sessions), with every session classified by source-identifier status and screen (Supplementary Table 3 ); and stance scores recomputed without segments in which any premise–hypothesis pair exceeded the 256-token limit (13.9% of the 2,043 segments of the registered confirmation sample).

blocks.en: The symptom tests were run with the registered code unchanged. Because the entailment scores took longer to compute than the embeddings, the discovery analysis was first run for the cosine scorers alone, by restricting the registered code’s list of scorers, and then for all three scorers; the cosine-scorer results of the two runs were identical. The confirmation analysis was run once, with all three scorers. The alliance tests were specified in a second analysis plan after the symptom tests had been analysed and before any session-quality label was compared with model output; the registered code for the stance scores was unchanged except for a setting of the number of processor threads, which does not affect the scores.

blocks.en: (i) The loader of the high- and low-quality counselling corpus mapped every missing or non-YouTube source address to the same empty identifier, which also occurred among the AnnoMI sources, so 21 sessions with a missing or non-YouTube source address (12 low and 9 high quality, one with a Vimeo address) were counted as shared with AnnoMI and excluded; 53 sessions share a video identifier with AnnoMI. The registered confirmation sample (184 sessions from 156 videos) is unchanged. A transcript screen then classified every session by source-identifier status and text match (Supplementary Table 3 ): 8 sessions of the registered confirmation sample matched AnnoMI material uploaded under another identifier, and 16 of the 21 excluded sessions were screen-negative. A negative screen does not establish independence, since sessions could share speakers, scripts or edited footage below the screen’s resolution. (ii) One PCL-C response (participant 683, hyperalertness item) was coded 0, outside the scale’s range of 1–5; we did not recode it, and excluding the participant left every registered conclusion unchanged (entailment-scorer H2: P = 0.049 P=0.049{} before multiplicity correction). (iii) In the probe-bank analysis, two AUDIT instruction stems and four duplicate VR-CoDES definitions had passed the filters; they were removed, and the reported bank results use the corrected set. (iv) Earlier simulations compared whitening with ridge-regularized deconvolution whose diagonal fit was valid only without the ridge; the comparison reported here uses exact deconvolution and reports how often its fits are inadmissible.

blocks.en: These analyses followed the registered tests and are exploratory. Their P P values are not adjusted for multiplicity (Supplementary Tables 1 – 3 ). For symptoms, we computed person-bootstrap intervals for H2 and Freedman–Lane tests with within-instrument permutations and registered controls. We examined within-speaker whitening under three control sets, person shuffles (main text, Fig. 4f), and length and topic baselines for paired read-outs (Supplementary Table 4 ). For alliance, we bootstrapped source videos, excluded transcript matches to AnnoMI, added previously excluded screen-negative sessions and excluded truncated segments. Stance scores separated the quality groups in every set, whereas the lower bound of the interval for their advantage over cosine scores lay on either side of zero depending on the set.
blocks.zh: 这些分析是在登记测试之后进行的,是探索性的。 它们的PP值不因多重性而作调整(补充表1至表3)。 对于症状,我们计算出H2和Freedman-Lane测试的人-包接间隔,并配有仪器内接和注册控制。 我们在三套控制下检查了口语内白化、个人洗发(主要文本,图4f)以及成对读取的长度和主题基线(补充表4)。 对于联盟,我们把原始视频拖出,排除了与AnnoMI的笔录匹配,增加了先前排除的屏幕阴性会话和排除了截断段. Stance的分数在每集中将质量组别分开,而相对于余弦分数,其优势的下限则由零分之一的两侧依集而分出.

blocks.en: Supplementary Table 6 lists the 35 probe banks. Item texts were transcribed from published forms, manuals or official websites and checked against a second source where available. For BDI-II, PANSS, SANS and SAPS, only available item titles or names were used, without copyrighted response options or definitions. Instruction and stem sentences were excluded. The three versions of the Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale were pooled after removing duplicate texts.
